item.text: The first model matches the plate’s orientation and overall proportions. I’m refining the opening position, thickness, and three narrow slots below the opening. You can follow the model in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8774/#part.FCStd).

item.text: The model now includes the rectangular opening, three narrow slots, and small mounting hole. It is valid as a single solid, and the four-view comparison shows a close silhouette match. I’m exporting the STEP file.
Created `part.FCStd` and exported `submission.step`. STEP readback confirms one valid solid matching the CAD model.
